label: 현재 질문에서 출발
hypothesis: 현재 질문·제안의 성격을 먼저 고정하면 관련성 기준을 다시 정의하는 왕복이 줄고 선택 근거가 현재 장면에 연결될 수 있다.
prefill: I will first identify what the counselor is asking and how the client is being invited to participate. I will then select personal traits relevant to understanding that situation, connect any supporting background, and explain each selection using the current context. Once these evidence links are clear, I can return the selections as JSON.
segment_count_note: Each text segment is tokenized independently; these are not API reasoning-token accounting.

label: 근거와 해석 구분
hypothesis: 현재 대화·기존 내면·프로필 원문을 구분하며 연결하면 라우팅이 이번 감정과 행동을 확정하는 단계로 확장되는 현상을 줄일 수 있다.
prefill: I will build each selection from an evidence link: a detail in the current conversation or existing inner note, a relevant trait in the profile, and any background that helps explain the connection. I will distinguish what the supplied records establish from my interpretation of their relevance. My conclusion will explain which personal information is useful for understanding this moment and why.
segment_count_note: Each text segment is tokenized independently; these are not API reasoning-token accounting.

label: 정보의 기여도 검토
hypothesis: 각 특성의 구체적인 기여도를 따지면 단순 주제 유사성으로 모두 선택하거나 배경 중복을 없애려고 불필요하게 조합을 바꾸는 현상이 줄어들 수 있다.
prefill: I will consider what each candidate contributes to understanding the client's perspective on this exchange. For each relevant trait, I will identify the specific belief, expectation, or coping tendency it clarifies and the supplied evidence for that connection. Related traits may contribute different aspects, and a shared background may support several connections. I will resolve uncertain links, then return the supported selections.
segment_count_note: Each text segment is tokenized independently; these are not API reasoning-token accounting.
